scope: Two independent one-line sample-only candidates; never a combined performance patch.
defaultSource: Fresh upstream main observed and pinned by setup before any native build; the target must still have the accepted Git blob.
preserved: Encoding.Default, exact valid length, independent materialized string before the await
Exact command case and command strings
Existing once-per-handler 4096-byte buffer allocation and lifetime
Bidirectional original memory reversal, awaited write, and subsequent full buffer clear
Existing await, cancellation, exceptions and teardown branches

sourceAndRuntimeBoundary.sampleOwners: Each independently source-built Original or observed-default sample owner with its own source/reference/restore graph.
sourceAndRuntimeBoundary.commonProducer: One independently rebuilt Original37 InMemory.FunctionalTests fixture/Kestrel producer closure, compiled once and identical for all variants.
sourceAndRuntimeBoundary.defaultLabelMeans: Current-default sample owner under the frozen common Original Kestrel/runtime57 producer; NOT a whole current-default framework/runtime validation.

functionalAcceptance.realProducer: Managed HTTP3 SETTINGS/CONNECT and actual WebTransport pending stream parser, publish and AcceptStreamAsync; actual compiled private sample handlers reached by test-side reflection delegates.
baselineAndEachIndependentCandidate: All ten prior compiled-sample ASCII, 9000-byte, stream ownership, exact Initiate Stream and Abort theory rows
All three unchanged native WebTransport session rows
Six new real-producer UTF8 rows: valid non-ASCII, invalid bytes and deliberately receipt-gated split sequence for each direction
Unidirectional exact decoded strings, including per-read replacement rather than a new stateful decoder
Bidirectional exact original-byte echo/reversal and ordinary-command handling for the non-ASCII/invalid/split rows; decoded ordinary strings are not directly logged on this path
One untimed 65536-byte workload inspection row with both genuine streams, exact byte/string consumers and complete teardown

performanceAcceptance.measurementFramework: Custom allocation/Stopwatch workload in the actual native InMemory.FunctionalTests fixture, not BenchmarkDotNet.
performanceAcceptance.primaryMetric: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(precise:true) delta for 128 completed 65536-byte operations on an already established actual sample stream
performanceAcceptance.secondaryMetric: Stopwatch elapsed for exactly the same completed operations
performanceAcceptance.payload: 65536 ASCII bytes with the fixed repeating printable pattern used by the accepted real-read producer
performanceAcceptance.variantOrder: Alternate baseline/candidate order by observation index
performanceAcceptance.F147Primary: Unidirectional real read, decode, console-string receipt and exact consumer comparison
performanceAcceptance.F147UnchangedControl: Bidirectional real read, decode/ordinary command, reversal, awaited echo and exact byte comparison
performanceAcceptance.F149Primary: Bidirectional real read, decode/ordinary command, reversal, awaited echo and exact byte comparison
performanceAcceptance.F149UnchangedControl: Unidirectional real read, decode, console-string receipt and exact consumer comparison
performanceAcceptance.caseOrderWithinProcess: Primary then control on even observations; control then primary on odd observations
performanceAcceptance.absoluteSavingExplanation: At least 90 percent of the 8388608-byte payload copied by ToArray over 128 operations; excludes array headers from the minimum.

admission.unusedThirdAuthorization: Permanently close unused; not a retry or tuning entitlement.
admission.publication: Fork-only independent drafts; each genuinely new justified draft gets its own visible new Edge window.

intentionalExclusions: Native QUIC/MsQuic, TLS, physical network, browser, routing and full sample startup/certificate setup
Stateful UTF8 decoding or repairing existing split-sequence behavior
Changing public API, package/SDK manifests or machine settings
